PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://hdev-crm-app-crm.jz4bvz.easypanel.host' -TimeoutSec 30 -UseBasicParsing -MaximumRedirection 5; Write-Output "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $t = $r.Content; if \($t.Length -gt 600\) { $t = $t.Substring\(0,600\) }; Write-Output $t } catch { Write-Output "Falhou: $\($_.Exception.Message\)"; if \($_.Exception.Response\) { Write-Output "HTTP: $\([int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode\)" } })

PowerShell($s = Get-Content hdevCRM\\db\\schema.rb; \($s[1130..1145] -join "`n"\); Write-Output '--- portals ---'; \($s[1306..1330] -join "`n"\) | Select-String -Pattern 'color' -Context 0,0; $s | Select-String -Pattern '"color", default' | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.LineNumber\): $\($_.Line.Trim\(\)\)" })

PowerShell(foreach \($t in 'magick','inkscape','rsvg-convert','node'\) { $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { Write-Output "$t : $\($c.Source\)" } else { Write-Output "$t : NAO" } })
